<parameter name="MPC_VC_MODE" default="0" type="INT32">
      <short_desc>Velocity controller request</short_desc>
      <long_desc>Accepts PID/AXES=0 or SITL ESTA/AXES=1..7 with valid independent gains. AX01 Y/XZ/YZ require DIV1. MODE2 remains reserved and rejected. R03 gate D admits MODE3 regularized explicit STA on NED X, Z, XY or XYZ (AXES=1/4/3/7), in SITL with DIV1 and valid gains/epsilon. Other MODE3 masks remain rejected. RI02 defines MODE4 compensated regularized implicit STA metadata only. Production MODE4 admission remains closed, regardless of parameters. Its offline contract reuses all 15 gain/limit/width values as one configuration. Armed requests are pending until disarm; requesting the effective configuration cancels pending changes. Original PID gain updates are unaffected.</long_desc>

        <value code="3">Regularized explicit STA X, Z, XY or XYZ (SITL only, R03 gate D)</value>
